title: A1 Final Review Part 4: Modal Verbs
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has superado con éxito la cuarta parte del Gran Repaso Final de A1.

parts.visual: Los verbos modales expresan habilidad, obligación o sugerencia. NO cambian con he/she/it (no llevan 's') y el verbo que les sigue va en su forma original (sin 'to').
parts.audio: Modal verbs express ability, obligation, or suggestion. They do not change with he, she, or it. And the verb after them is in its original form, without 'to'.

parts.visual: CAN (habilidad/permiso): I can swim. Can I help you? MUST (obligación fuerte): You must wear a uniform. SHOULD (sugerencia/consejo): You should rest. WOULD LIKE (deseo formal): I would like a coffee.
parts.audio: CAN for ability or permission. I can swim. MUST for strong obligation. You must wear a uniform. SHOULD for suggestions. You should rest. WOULD LIKE for polite requests. I would like a coffee.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el verbo modal o la forma verbal correcta.

questions.question: You ____ wear a helmet on the construction site. It's the law. (Obligación).
You look tired. You ____ take a break. (Sugerencia).
I ____ like a cup of coffee, please. (Deseo formal).
questions.explanation: Deseo o petición formal = would like.

questions.question: She can ____ the piano. (Tocar).
questions.explanation: Después de un modal, el verbo va sin 'to': play.

questions.question: We must ____ the report today. (Terminar).
questions.explanation: Después de must, el verbo va sin 'to': finish.

questions.question: He should ____ to the doctor. (Ir).
questions.explanation: Después de should, el verbo va sin 'to': go.

questions.question: ____ I open the window? (Permiso/Ofrecimiento).
questions.explanation: Pedir permiso u ofrecer = Can I...?

questions.question: They ____ not enter this room. It's private. (Prohibición).
I ____ to leave now. (Tengo que).
questions.explanation: Si lleva 'to', no puede ser un modal puro. Usamos 'have to'.

questions.question: We ____ cancel the meeting. The CEO is sick. (Debemos).
You shouldn't ____ late. (Llegar).
questions.explanation: Después de shouldn't, verbo base: arrive.

questions.question: ____ you help me with this box? (¿Puedes...?).
I would ____ to speak to the manager. (Me gustaría).
You don't ____ to come if you are busy. (No tienes que / No es necesario).
questions.explanation: Falta de obligación = don't have to.

questions.question: I ____ fix this issue. It's too difficult. (No puedo).
____ we start the presentation? (¿Deberíamos / Empezamos?).
questions.explanation: Pedir consejo o sugerir empezar = Should we...?

questions.question: Visitors ____ wear a badge at all times. (Obligación).
If you want to improve, you ____ practice every day. (Consejo).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe can, must, should o would.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I can speak English and Spanish.
options: I can speak English and Spanish.
I can speak English and French.
He can speak English and Spanish.
I can read English and Spanish.
questions.correct_answer: I can speak English and Spanish.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I would like a cup of coffee.
options: I would like a cup of coffee.
I would like a cup of tea.
He would like a cup of coffee.
I'd like a cup of coffee.
questions.correct_answer: I would like a cup of coffee.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They must not enter this room.
options: They must not enter this room.
You must not enter this room.
They should not enter this room.
We must not enter this room.
questions.correct_answer: They must not enter this room.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Can you help me with this box?
options: Can you help me with this box?
Could you help me with this box?
Can he help me with this box?
Can you help me with this bag?
questions.correct_answer: Can you help me with this box?
